Yuki has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. You were listening. Now you know Spicebush too.

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 1 skill from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Peyton Ye. Postal worker. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dog tags, Dead Phone, Boot stone, Dispatcher's headset, Unnamed photograph. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wr
A woman, maybe 20s: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
You tell the others you're heading out. Someone nods. "Come back before dark."
— DAY 1 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 24L left.
